_source: Essence System v0.6 Google Doc, Part XIV 'Starting Enemy Examples' (export lines 7187-7375, read 2026-09-27). Playtest references; fictional presentation is the GM's.

enemies.name: Mook Skirmisher

abilities.name: Harrier Strike
abilities.text: Range 1; vs. Fortitude. On success, deal 1 Physical Slashing Damage. Surge 1: move 1 unit after resolution.

abilities.name: Slip Away
abilities.text: Trigger: an adjacent enemy targets you with an opposed Action. Roll 2d10, unopposed. Gain +1 Fortitude against the triggering Action. If it fails to affect you, move 1 unit after it resolves.

enemies.roleUse: Force target switching, chase vulnerable characters, and make position matter. Do not use several if the battlefield is too cramped for movement to be meaningful.

enemies.name: Mook Striker

abilities.name: Opening Strike
abilities.text: Range 1; vs. Fortitude. On success, deal 1 Physical Piercing Damage. Surge 2: deal +1 Damage.

abilities.name: Exploit the Opening
abilities.text: Before rolling Opening Strike against a target that is Exposed, Restrained, or has no other ally within 2 units, gain 1 free die for that Action. Add it to the printed roll; no Pool is spent.

enemies.roleUse: Threaten a compromised or isolated target while other enemies hold attention. No native Reaction; only two Wounds and no Resilience, so it relies on positioning and supporting allies.

enemies.name: Mook Support

abilities.name: Set Up
abilities.text: Roll 2d10, unopposed. Choose one ally within 4 units. That ally gains 1 free die on its next Action before the start of your next Turn.

abilities.name: Emergency Cover
abilities.text: When an ally within 3 units would suffer a Wound, grant that ally 1 Temporary Wound before the Wound is resolved. This is not a Reaction and cannot be used if the Support is unable to detect the ally.

enemies.roleUse: The Mook itself is fragile; its value comes from making another enemy more efficient. Players who identify and remove it should feel the encounter become easier.

enemies.name: Normal Defender

abilities.name: Hold the Line
abilities.text: Range 1; vs. Fortitude. On success, deal 1 Physical Bludgeoning Damage and move the target 1 unit. Surge 1: the target becomes Exposed until the end of its next Turn.

abilities.name: Interpose
abilities.text: Trigger: an adjacent ally is targeted by a physically obstructable attack. Roll 2d10, unopposed. The ally gains +1 Fortitude against the triggering attack; after resolution you may exchange spaces with that ally if both can legally occupy the new spaces.

abilities.name: Brace
abilities.text: At the start of your Turn, increase Resilience by 2 until the start of your next Turn.

enemies.roleUse: Place the Defender where players can choose whether to break through, go around, attack another Defense, or force the Defender away from the objective.

enemies.name: Normal Striker

abilities.name: Punishing Strike
abilities.text: Range 1; vs. Fortitude. On success, deal 1 Physical Slashing Damage. If the target is Exposed, Restrained, or has no other ally within 2 units, deal +1 Damage. Surge 2: deal +1 Damage.

abilities.name: Commit
abilities.text: Before rolling Punishing Strike, gain 1 free die and become Exposed until the end of your next Turn.

enemies.roleUse: Threaten isolated or already-compromised targets. Its best Damage should come from setup by other Roles rather than unconditional output.

enemies.name: Normal Controller

abilities.name: Deny Ground
abilities.text: Roll 2d10, unopposed. Choose a point within 5 units. Create Difficult Terrain in a Sphere with hex radius 1 (7 hexes) until the start of your next Turn. Creatures entering the area for the first time each Turn lose 1 additional Movement.

abilities.name: Bind Position
abilities.text: Once between Recoveries. Range 4; vs. Fortitude or Harmony, chosen when the enemy is built. On success, the target becomes Immobilized until the end of its next Turn. Surge 2: also make the target Exposed for the same duration.

enemies.roleUse: Change paths and timing rather than dealing much Damage. A Controller becomes more dangerous when a Striker or Blaster can exploit the spaces it denies.

enemies.name: Normal Blaster

abilities.name: Burst
abilities.text: Choose a point within 6 units; Sphere with hex radius 1 (7 hexes); vs. Fortitude. On success, each affected enemy suffers 1 Physical Force Damage. Surge 2: choose one successfully affected creature to suffer +1 Damage.

abilities.name: Scatter
abilities.text: After Burst resolves, move each successfully affected creature 1 unit directly away from the Sphere center if that space is legal.

enemies.roleUse: Discourage clustering and create a reason to spread out. Do not combine several Blasters unless the battlefield gives players enough room to respond.

enemies.name: Elite Champion

abilities.name: Champion Strike
abilities.text: Minimum 3 dice; Range 1; vs. Fortitude. On success, deal 2 Physical Slashing Damage. Surge 2: move the target 1 unit or move yourself 1 unit after resolution.

abilities.name: Challenge
abilities.text: Minimum 2 dice; Range 4; vs. Composure. On success, the target suffers -1 to all Defenses against the Champion until the end of the target's next Turn. This is not Exposed and therefore can stack with Exposed.

abilities.name: Turn Aside
abilities.text: Trigger: you are targeted by an opposed Action. Minimum 2 dice, unopposed. Gain +1 to the targeted Defense against the triggering Action. Surge 2: move 1 unit after it resolves.

enemies.roleUse: A Champion is an Elite ordinary enemy, not automatically a Boss. It can anchor a Severe or Critical encounter alongside other enemies without changing the encounter into a Leader or Solo structure.

enemies.name: Elite Leader

abilities.name: Command Strike
abilities.text: Minimum 3 dice; Range 5; vs. Composure. On success, the target becomes Exposed until the end of its next Turn. One ally within 5 units may move 2 units after resolution.

abilities.name: Coordinated Assault
abilities.text: Once per Round. When an ally successfully affects an Exposed enemy, another ally within 5 units gains 1 free die on its next Action before the start of the Leader's next Turn.

abilities.name: Redirect
abilities.text: Trigger: an ally within 4 units is targeted by an opposed Action. Minimum 2 dice, unopposed. Move that ally 1 unit. If the movement makes the ally an illegal target, the triggering Action fails against that ally normally.

enemies.roleUse: Boss example. The Leader becomes less dangerous as supporting enemies disappear. Build the Boss encounter around that relationship rather than increasing the Leader's Wound capacity.

enemies.name: Elite Solo

abilities.name: Crushing Action
abilities.text: Minimum 3 dice; Range 1; vs. Fortitude. On success, deal 2 Physical Bludgeoning Damage. Surge 1: move yourself or the target 1 unit after resolution.

abilities.name: Pressure Wave
abilities.text: Triggered Ability, once per Round. After the second enemy Turn other than the Solo's own Turn ends in a Round, choose a point within 3 units. Creatures other than the Solo within 1 unit of that point must each move 1 unit away from the point if possible. This is forced movement, not another full Turn.

abilities.name: Solo Reaction Limit
abilities.text: The Solo may use up to two Reactions in a Round, but still no more than one response within any single Reaction chain. Each Reaction must have a legal trigger and be paid normally.

abilities.name: Adaptive Guard
abilities.text: Trigger: the Solo is targeted by an opposed Action. Minimum 2 dice, unopposed. Gain +1 to the targeted Defense against the triggering Action. If the Action fails, the Solo may move 1 unit after resolution.

enemies.roleUse: Boss example. The Solo remains active between its own Turns without receiving several complete PC-like Turns. The triggered ability should be visible and predictable once it occurs so players can respond tactically.
